question: Since the October 2024 decision of the Court of Justice of the European Union (CJEU) and the provisional application of the amendments to the EU-Morocco Association Agreement, no new report has been issued on the benefits of that agreement extending tariff preferences to products originating in Western Sahara.

In a response to a previous written question1, the Commission provided a link to the 2023 report issued in March 2024. However, no new report has been made publicly available. This is concerning given that the amended EU-Morocco Association Agreement, responding to a CJEU decision, has been in provisional application for nine months. 1.
What is the timeline for the publication of a new report on benefits?
Will the new report cover the period since the amendments to the EU-Morocco Association Agreement have been in provisional application?
Will the new report provide detail on the control mechanism referred to in the amended agreement?
